findings.detail: Schedule heading and subtotal rows are non-instrument rows with blank rate fields, while adjacent debt instrument rows carry populated interest rates; leaked heading/subtotal rows depress dl_rate_fill.

rationale: The source schedule has explicit Interest Rate columns. Instrument rows such as table 13 rows 5-7 contain asset type, reference spread, interest rate, maturity, par, cost, and fair value. By contrast, table 13 rows 3-4 are section/industry headings and row 8 is a subtotal line with only aggregate cost/fair-value values and no issuer, asset type, spread, maturity, or interest rate. The bundle's holdings slice includes analogous heading-like direct-lending records with blank interest_rate, so the rate-fill warning reflects real row-disposition leakage rather than legitimate debt instruments without disclosed rates.
